title: Position: The Complexity of Perfect AI Alignment – Formalizing the RLHF Trilemma
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a theoretical position paper about the trade-offs in AI alignment.
findings: This paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its main argument is the 'Alignment Trilemma,' a theoretical framework positing that no Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) system can simultaneously achieve representativeness of diverse human values, computational tractability, and robustness against adversarial shifts.
references: Long Ouyang, Jeff Wu, Xu Jiang, et al. Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback. In Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 2022.
